info.name: Diet Management API
info.description:
Comprehensive API collection for Diet Management App.

Covers all modules:
- Health: Liveness/readiness probes
- Auth: Google OAuth authentication
- Users: Profile management with BMR/BMI
- Calculator: Health metrics calculation
- Tracking: Weight and glucose logging
- Plans: Nutrition plan management
- Foods: Food database with categories and servings
- Meals: Meal logging and daily summaries

Version: 1.0.0
Last Updated: January 2026
